claim_boundaries.nauria-survey-2024: Secondary survey supports a narrowly attributed name/classification only. No boat-specific performer, transcription, origin or general rhythmic pattern established. Do not relabel the Halia example.
claim_boundaries.ora-chaiti-2009: Historic official performance description; Rama/horse account is explicitly legend. No present-day calendar, universal practice or work-song equivalence established.
claim_boundaries.boat-song-interview-2019: Primary maker interview about a modern adaptation; Bengali inspiration attributed to producer, not independently established folk-song genealogy. No listening or licensing claim.
claim_boundaries.editorial: Category distinctions and suggested questions are editorial synthesis. No named literary work is analysed or invented; literary imagery is a caution for future identification.

recovery: Original CCRT, maritime-review and NFDB leads remain unavailable and excluded from accepted claims. Alternate full-text sources support this bounded introduction. Earlier checkpoint preserved as historical evidence.
follow_up: Identify a named practitioner and locality through an authorized future project; document repertoire and transmission with consent.

limitations: A source-based introduction, not a complete inventory of Odisha’s boat or fishing songs. No field recording, lyrics, practitioner review or single ancient origin is claimed. Local names, variants and transmission histories remain open to further evidence.
